Assistant (18.3s): For your personal loan, the latest date I can record is Friday 23 October 2026. Can you pay the 900.00 for the loan by that date?

User (23.5s): Yes, thirty.

User (26.0s): Yes, I confirm.

Assistant (28.7s): Your promise is recorded. You will receive a text message confirming this promise. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

User (29.7s): Thank you, goodbye.

Assistant (29.7s): Thank you, Ms Rossi. Goodbye.

Assistant (16.2s): I can certainly help you with that. Please hold a moment while I transfer you to our restructuring team.

Assistant (18.5s): Thank you for your time, Mr Ionescu. Goodbye.

Assistant (30.8s): Thank you for your time, Mr Bell. Goodbye.

User (25.9s): Thank you, goodbye.
